messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy disappearing entirely is unlikely because encryption, law, protest, and offline choices will leave meaningful zones of seclusion even as surveillance expands Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s is extremely unlikely because we cannot yet fully read, replicate, or prove the subjective self in silicon Consciousness
Wireless Internet everywhere on our planet is moderately likely for most inhabited surfaces but less likely in oceans, polar ice, high altitude, and remote terrain Wireless
Electric transport eventually becoming universal is plausible for cars and trains but much less likely for all ships, aircraft, and off-road machines due to energy density and infrastructure limits Electric
Climate change effects becoming irreversible are highly likely for centuries because ice loss, ocean heat, sea-level rise, and ecosystem collapse can continue after emissions stop Climate
Physical money disappearing completely is unlikely because cash supports privacy, resilience, access, and informal exchange even as digital payments dominate Physical
Genetic secrets enabling centuries or forever life are extremely unlikely in the near term because aging involves many interacting systems and not just one code error Genetic
